description: Return raw per-project audit artifacts for all detected supported roots, report unsupported roots, and list roots whose adapter failed in failedProjects. Use when a downstream specialist tool needs project-audits/v1; for a general first-pass review, prefer review_repository. The result can be large; specialist tools also accept repoRoot directly, so the artifact rarely needs to be passed back.

changedPaths.description: Optional repository-relative source paths to limit target selection.

excludeProjectRoots.description: Optional project roots or subtree patterns such as examples/** to exclude before auditing detected projects.

goarch.description: Explicit GOARCH for bounded Go build-constraint evaluation.

goos.description: Explicit GOOS for bounded Go build-constraint evaluation.

tags.description: Optional custom Go build tags passed to the target-aware verification command.

swiftSchemes.description: Optional shared Xcode scheme per Swift project root. Keys are detected project roots.

name: audit_projects

outputSchema.description: Top-level shape of this artifact. The complete contract is schemas/project-audits-v1.schema.json in the published package.

title: Audit Projects
